root_cause: ResourceNode sources are finite and remain registered after exhaustion. Before repair, RMB Gather UX still accepted exhausted nodes into the gather flow and rejection text was generic, so depletion of both visible sources appeared to be a global lifecycle failure. Starting a new Gather with existing cargo also lacked an explicit deposit-first transition.
worker_stopped_reason_before_fix: The selected finite resource source reached CurrentResources == 0; the order completed after returning final cargo. The UI did not clearly expose exhaustion.
